stages.effectText: When consuming DP, each point of DP increases ATK by 2% for the skill duration (up to 10 stacks)

Attack range increases during skill activation. Activating a skill unleashes a Morph Slash that deals damage and consumes all skill charges; each charge increases the skill duration by 40% and gives +2% ATK during the skill.
